data.name: Kairos
data.description: Kairos Carbon, founded in 2024 and headquartered in Ingatestone, United Kingdom, is a CDR pure-play developing a novel supercritical water oxidation process for durable carbon removal. Its advanced hydrothermal processing system turns biogenic carbon from difficult-to-treat waste feedstocks into CO2, clean water and valuable minerals, with the CO2 permanently stored underground in exchange for carbon credits and phosphorus recovered as fertiliser.
